en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not cut the bread with the knife, but cut it by the hand, and oppose the non-Arabs’.
en.sarwar: 14. Afi ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ’Isa from Yunus who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Do not cut bread with knife, instead break it with the hands and do the opposite of al-Ajam (non- Arabs).”’
